purpose: Explainable external-market decision support for Bedashing UAE.

branch_model.customer_signal: One 35%-weighted customer component: 60% Bayesian rating quality, 25% analysed positive-minus-negative sentiment balance, 10% analysed review evidence, and 5% sample coverage. Sentiment is rating-based and is not treated as an independent top-level signal.
branch_model.review_topics: Arabic/English deterministic topic mentions are explanatory evidence only and cannot independently change PROTECT/HOLD/SHRINK.
branch_model.competitive_position: 65% relative weighted-rating gap + 35% inverse direct-competitor density
branch_model.network_value: Percentile of unique 10-minute coverage; self-overlap is shown as the inverse risk signal and is not double-counted

thresholds.SHRINK: health < 40 AND below-median unique coverage OR material self-overlap

branch_model.guardrail: SHRINK means priority for internal commercial review, never automatic closure.

growth_model.source: Existing opportunity_score and GROW/WATCH/SKIP classification from 07_build_whitespace.py
growth_model.cluster_priority_score: 70% maximum cell opportunity + 30% mean cluster opportunity
growth_model.note: Adjacent GROW H3 cells are presented as one market cluster, not separate branch openings.

known_limitations: No revenue, profit, rent, bookings, utilization or customer-origin data.
Google Places competitors are observed candidates, not an exhaustive UAE business census.
OpenRouteService catchments are modelled from the road network and are not live-traffic or observed-customer catchments.
WorldPop is a modelled gridded population estimate, not branch-level demand or spending.
Review sentiment is derived from review stars; topic extraction uses deterministic bilingual keywords rather than a contextual language model.
All recommendations require human review and internal commercial validation.
